corrections: wm-wifi.md: Avoid implying that room count or an idle client necessarily reduces throughput.
wm-wifi.md: Avoid an absolute product-specific speed claim.
wm-wifi.questions.json: The original broader potential-benefit question also admitted higher QAM as reducing airtime; narrow the tested mechanisms to preserve the intended three answers.
wm-wifi.questions.json: Clarify that16µs is the SIFS duration, not the18µs difference.
wm-wifi.questions.json: Bands alone do not establish a uniform timing difference; avoid treating EDCA as DCF.
wm-wifi.questions.json: Avoid guaranteed continued collisions with identical shifted waits and random backoff.
wm-cellular.md: Do not assert a universal dominant contribution without a measured workload.
wm-cellular.md: Random access still involves contention, as the lesson explains.
wm-cellular.md: Remove unsupported ranking of application effects.
wm-cellular.md: Qualify energy claim; RRC connection states are not literal power levels.
wm-cellular.md: Remove universal promotion requirement contradicted by retained contexts and inactive-state features.
wm-cellular.md: Avoid unsupported universal deployment behaviour and numerical range.
wm-cellular.questions.json: RRC-connected status alone does not prove an IP address was allocated during attach.
wm-cellular.questions.json: Intra-base-station handover invalidates every-handover node-change claim.
wm-cellular.questions.json: Avoid an unnecessary universal prohibition on all SIM data.
wm-cellular.questions.json: Channel state/history can influence initial link adaptation.
wm-cellular.questions.json: No universal later-packet discard after expiration.
wm-cellular.questions.json: Avoid claiming every port is necessarily translated.
wm-cellular.questions.json: Energy cost is workload dependent and keepalive detection is conditional.
wm-cellular.questions.json: Do not categorically exclude load-related mobility decisions.
wm-datacentre.md: Avoid implying all facilities replaced one topology.
wm-datacentre.md: Same-branch traffic need not traverse core.
wm-datacentre.md: Path variation can reorder, not inevitably.
wm-datacentre.md: Flow count alone does not guarantee byte balance.
wm-datacentre.md: Topology and mappings determine polarisation; distinct seeds are a mitigation, not universal guarantee.
wm-datacentre.md: RFC8257 alpha estimates marking fraction; low queues not guaranteed.
wm-datacentre.questions.json: No supplied ASIC evidence for universal cost equivalence.
wm-datacentre.questions.json: Align conditional reordering claim with explanation.
wm-datacentre.questions.json: Restrict load-blindness to specified selector, not all ECMP implementations.
wm-datacentre.questions.json: Avoid every cross-rack path reaching core and guaranteed use of all paths.
wm-datacentre.questions.json: Not every resilient implementation guarantees exactly only failed flows move.
wm-datacentre.questions.json: Remove every-connection universal claim.
wm-datacentre.questions.json: For mod2→mod1, healthy-member flows do not remap; original generalized rehash implication misleading.
wm-sdn.md: A recommendation is not a universal implementation requirement or balanced-path guarantee.
wm-sdn.questions.json: Prompt does not restrict traffic to TCP SYNs or guarantee every new flow waits exactly one RTT.
wm-sdn.questions.json: Do not infer complete capacity validation from some covered traffic continuing.
wm-sdn.questions.json: Remove controller fallback explicitly excluded by prompt.
wm-sdn.questions.json: OpenFlow barrier completion alone is not successful flow installation: preceding errors must be checked.
wm-debugging.questions.json: Local rejection need not imply a remote reply.
wm-debugging.questions.json: Later low RTT does not prove all earlier transit traffic avoided delay.
wm-debugging.questions.json: Original option was a consistent hypothesis too, making single-answer question ambiguous.
wm-debugging.questions.json: Prompt does not establish login by name and DNS correctness is not universal.
wm-debugging.questions.json: Avoid treating restart outcome as proven while cause remains a hypothesis.
wm-debugging.questions.json: Loss need not be visible in one finite capture.
wm-debugging.questions.json: Do not make a universal signature claim or exclude coexistence.
wm-debugging.questions.json: Not every host/provider table failure prints the Linux message.
wm-debugging.questions.json: Explicit binding/source addresses/configuration qualify universal ephemeral-only limit and unique fix.
wm-debugging.md: Table exhaustion does not guarantee a local kernel log.
wm-debugging.md: The1.22 coefficient assumes ACK ratio1; delayed ACKs change model coefficient.
wm-internet-structure.md: Remove undated count inconsistent with evidence-limits paragraph.
wm-internet-structure.md: IXP size and peering agreements vary.
wm-internet-structure.md: Recovery method varies; not every repair uses grappling or identical sequence.
wm-internet-structure.md: Fast has no defined cutoff; remove absolute distance threshold.
wm-internet-structure.questions.json: Avoid universal every-address transit guarantee.
wm-internet-structure.questions.json: Do not generalize unpaid prevalence from a supplied example.
wm-internet-structure.questions.json: Downstream is broadcast from OLT, not homes contending or taking upstream-style turns.
wm-internet-structure.questions.json: Unsupported200ms specific estimate absent from prompt removed.
wm-internet-structure.questions.json: Original explanation reversed where P2 learns destination route.
wm-internet-structure.questions.json: Remove stale reference to historical real-site/many-network scenario.
wm-debugging.md: Original Mathis Table1 distinguishes periodic1.22 from random-loss1.31 and delayed-ACKcoefficients.
wm-sdn.md: OpenFlow1.3.5section5.4 permits configuration overriding default.
wm-internet-structure.md: ITU distinguishes10Gbps class from precise nominal line rate.
